name: Nexus-Research-Intelligence-System
purpose: Create a multi-agent AI research company that receives a business question, researches the topic using multiple sources, verifies and compares the evidence, performs financial and market analysis, identifies risks and uncertainties, writes an executive report, and has a final reviewer validate the report before delivery.

members.name: researcher
members.purpose: Research the business question using multiple relevant sources.

members.name: verifier
members.purpose: Verify, compare, and qualify the research evidence.

members.name: market_analyst
members.purpose: Perform financial and market analysis from verified evidence.

members.name: risk_analyst
members.purpose: Identify material risks, uncertainties, assumptions, and missing evidence.

members.name: writer
members.purpose: Produce a clear executive report from the team's evidence and analysis.

members.name: reviewer
members.purpose: Validate the final report against evidence, analysis, risks, and acceptance criteria.
